title: AutoCrowd
tagline: On-chain AI-powered crowdfunding with milestone reviews and PYUSD funding.
description: AutoCrowd is an AI-powered decentralized crowdfunding platform that combines blockchain technology with intelligent agent systems to make fundraising more transparent and automated. It allows users to create and fund campaigns using PYUSD, a stablecoin equalant to the US dollar, ensuring stable and predictable transactions. When a campaign creator sets up a project, they define milestones that must be achieved to unlock funds. Instead of relying on manual or centralized verification, AutoCrowd uses ASI (Autonomous Software Intelligence) agents to automatically verify whether these milestones are completed. These agents operate through a reasoning system called the MeTTa Knowledge Graph and coordinate via the AgentVerse platform. Once the agents confirm milestone completion, smart contracts written in Solidity handle the release of funds securely on the Ethereum (Sepolia) network.
how_its_made: The project is built using a modern and scalable architecture. The frontend is developed with Next.js (React + TypeScript) and Tailwind CSS, providing an intuitive interface where users can connect their wallets using @walletconnet, view campaigns, and contribute funds. The backend, powered by Node.js and Express, handles business logic, communicates with the blockchain, and manages requests from the frontend. Data is stored securely in a PostgreSQL database with supabase. The blockchain layer is managed using Foundry for development and Ethers.js for interaction. All contracts are verified and check on the blockscout, Milestone is verified with the ASI agent and the Transcations are done using PYUSD faucets provided by google web3 faucet provider
